title: Making the Commitment
metaDescription: Share your thoughts on achieving your goal. Learn the key steps for setting impactful goals in this engaging blog post.

author: Devon RD
bodyHtml: So… what did you decide on? We have spent the last four weeks going through how to set goals that will really move the needle. Now it is time to make those commitments, and we would love to know what they are. Comment your thoughts and goals on this post, as well as any topics you would like to see me dig into a bit more in the coming year.
